arguments.sql:
SELECT r.date, COUNT(*) AS records, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS ruling_ids,
       COUNT(DISTINCT r.uuid) AS printings, COUNT(DISTINCT r.text) AS statements
FROM main.rulings AS r
JOIN main.cards AS c ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Mishra''s Factory'
GROUP BY r.date
ORDER BY r.date DESC
